### Map

```{r tabsets, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
  observe({ #update th county selection
   updateSelectInput(session, "County", choices = unique(spatial_data()$County))
  })

 #if exists(merged_data)
  # print("merged_data exists")
  # Render Leaflet Map
output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    
    sp <- spatial_data() # store the spatial county data

    map <- leaflet(sp) %>%# tis dataset store the information (store map as out)
      addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%
      clearShapes() %>%
      addPolygons(
        stroke = TRUE, smoothFactor = 0.1,
      fillOpacity = 0.2,
      layerId = ~County
      )
    
    map
  })
  
  # click county
click_county <- eventReactive(input$map_shape_click, {  
  #Observes the CLICKING in a MAP
  x <- input$map_shape_click
  y <- x$id
  return(y)
  
  })

county_numbers <- reactive({  #creates a variable that user can modify the output of via input (click)
  input$map_shape_click$id
  clicked_id <- input$map_shape_click$id # Get the id of the clicked shape, THIS is county
  print(clicked_id) # Print the clicked ID, returns county
})

observe({
  req(county_numbers())
  proxy <- leafletProxy("map")
  sub <- dplyr::filter(spatial_data(), County %in% county_numbers())
  
  box <- st_bbox(sub) %>% as.vector()
  
  # Check if 'sub' is empty
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) {
    return(NULL) # No data to display
  }
  
  # Clear old selection on map, and add new selection
  proxy %>%      #When I click on a shape, this will make sure the NEW shape is highlighted and clear previous.
    clearGroup(group = "sub") %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = sub, fill = FALSE, color = "#FFFF00", #color assigned to newer polygons
      opacity = 1, group = "sub", weight = 1.5
    ) %>%
    fitBounds( #bounds of the polygon as array
      lng1 = box[1],
      lat1 = box[2],
      lng2 = box[3],
      lat2 = box[4]
    )
})


# Capture and highlight clicked county
  observeEvent(click_county(), {   #output depends on the click_county() function
  # Add the clicked tract to the map in aqua, and remove when a new one is clicked
  map <- leafletProxy("map") %>%
    removeShape("County") %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = filter(spatial_data(), County == click_county()), fill = FALSE,
      color = "#00FFFF", opacity = 1, layerId = "County",
      weight = 1.2
    )
})

county_data <- reactive({
  # Fetch data for the clicked tract
  return(filter(texas_confirmed_cases(), County == click_county()))  #spatial_data was changed for texas_confirmed cases 
}) # they both contain County as an id so it should not cause any "trouble"

leafletOutput("map")
```
